reviewer: an independent reviewer agent that saw only the screenshots (no code); nine fresh reviewers in all, one per round
page: #/evolution/12124 with the six proposals (forecast range, filière band, « Votre bac » year by year, demand, call depth, offer timing)
screens: wide 1360 px light and dark (full page); every card on a phone 393 px for a bac général profile with an average and for a bac techno profile; the first six in dark and without a profile

colour_readability.why: Line series are clearly separated: navy or cream heavy line, red dashed, light-blue dashed, grey dotted, teal/olive/violet routes. TB félicitations, Très bien and Bien are close browns; thin top segments carry no label.

colour_blind_safety.why: Line charts back colour with dashes, hollow points, squares and diamonds. The stacked bars rely on order and hue; small techno and pro segments cannot be told apart without colour (the latest year is written under the bars).

personal_curves.why: The student's line is the heaviest, tagged « vous » / « votre bac » with a bold first legend entry, in every profile. The tag sits near overlapping techno/pro lines in the bac techno route chart.

legend_and_labels.why: Legends right above each chart, marker keys right under it. On the phone some legends wrap on 2-3 lines; the 2026 box's range is printed in the note, not beside the box.

honesty_wording.why: Almost every card says « pas une chance » or « des parts d'admis, pas des chances »; estimates carry the tag; rare routes read « rare, pas fermée »; the forecast states its tested coverage (77 %).

hierarchy.why: Title card and official rate, then the personal cards, then access, routes, demand and the counts table. Uneven card heights leave gaps on wide screens.

style_fidelity.why: Thick ink edges, hard offset shadows, Space Grotesk and straight charts across all cards; the estimation chips fit the style.

phone_layout.why: No overflow, readable sizes. The counts table squeezes its labels; 11 long cards with wrapped legends.

dark_theme.why: The student's line becomes cream; blue, red and teal stay clear; bar chips stay readable. The grey band and the darkest brown are low-contrast on near-black.

overall_polish.why: Clean and consistent. Remaining: a tag near overlapping lines, the 2026 box without its value beside it, unlabelled small segments, uneven heights on wide screens.

measured_on: EV1-EV9 and EV13-EV18 all pass on the real warehouse, EV9 in Chromium (7 screens)
suggestions: More lightness steps (or a hatch) for TB félicitations; a lighter dark-mode swatch.
Print the forecast range next to its box and join it to the last point.
A wider label column for the counts table on a phone.
A dashed outline on the filière band in dark mode.
Label small stacked segments with a leader.
